text: Based on the Earth-observation evidence, the property appears to be legally compliant regarding forests. No tree-cover loss events of 0.5 hectares or larger were detected within the asset between 2021 and 2025. While small patches of loss (under 0.5 ha) were observed after the 2020 baseline, these are not counted as significant events. The data also confirms there was no forest cover in 2020 (0.0% of the asset). The assessment does not establish compliance with specific regulations (e.g., EUDR), but it shows no detectable deforestation occurred during the claim period.
